# routeros_certificate_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `builtin_trust_store` (String) Specifies which services may use the built-in trust store authorities for certificate verification. Accepts a comma-separated list of service names, or one of the shortcuts `all`, `default` (the set reported by `current_defaults`) and `untrusted` (no service).
- `crl_download` (Boolean) Whether to automatically download and update the CRLs.
- `crl_store` (String) Where the downloaded CRL information is stored.
  * ram - keep the CRLs in RAM only;
  * system - store the CRLs on the system disk.
- `crl_use` (Boolean) Whether every certificate in a chain is verified against its CRL.
- `current_defaults` (String) A comma-separated list of the services that the `default` value of `builtin_trust_store` expands to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
